description: This file defines the EditDropDownWizard class for the SuiteCRM Studio module. It provides methods for user interface flow such as welcome, back, process, and display, and manages dropdown editing functionalities.

classes.name: EditDropDownWizard
classes.description: A wizard class for editing dropdown lists within SuiteCRM Studio, extending StudioWizard and managing dropdown-related user flows.

methods.name: welcome
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the purpose of the wizard.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Handles the user action to go back to the previous page or module, cleaning output buffer and redirecting accordingly.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes user options, including editing or saving dropdowns, and loads appropriate views.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides parent display function; intentionally left blank to suppress wizard display.
